design_selection: explicit policies and only actually calibrated deployments; generated counts are design bookkeeping, not reviewer-mandated sample sizes or independent N

review_alignment.R1.4_R2.12_R3.3: board-local generated content, functional state changes and real peer-to-receiver processing; the completed no-UART calibration alone cannot show controlled physical-path outcomes
review_alignment.R2.4_R3.2: charge network and guard in one modeled total action budget and measure controller, applying control, inference, API/guard, communication and actual safe serial time separately
review_alignment.R2.11: representative development-board endpoint execution and safe MCU ECHO, not physical robot motion or commercial-product performance
review_alignment.existing_evidence_reused: completed large-network target-aware PPR/MPC, adaptive/observation-error, sensitivity and theoretical studies retain their own simulation scope; no complete hardware rerun of those matrices
review_alignment.policy_selection_reason: no-control establishes the causal reference, static guard isolates execution protection, original CAGMC tests the implemented combined feedback policy; this subset cannot establish native superiority over the omitted strong policies
review_alignment.family_selection_reason: all twenty archived held-out content mechanisms, disjoint from these twenty fitted native calibration families, are retained before policy observations; no favorable-family selection and no new-blind claim
review_alignment.round_selection_reason: four rounds with external input at rounds zero and two provide an initial response, forwarding/feedback and one defense-observing re-attack; known first-input detection lag remains unmodified
review_alignment.deployment_selection_reason: only the two actual fitted model-host-role combinations; unobserved swapped configurations are not imputed or transferred
review_alignment.cost_interpretation: the 0.8 normalized budget and 0.25 guard price are prospective bounded testbed settings, not measured time/energy exchange rates or the large-network operating point
review_alignment.execution_scope: each segment requires an explicit index; failures stop collection without automatic retry, replacement or launch of the next segment

timing_aggregation: elapsed_trial_seconds measures the actual coordinator critical path including reset, delivery, observation/control, concurrent generation, execution and peer forwarding; nested and concurrent phase times are diagnostics and must not be summed as end-to-end latency

analysis.paired_policy_comparator: cagmc_joint minus each explicitly selected comparator
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over 2 selected baseline contrasts times three primary outcomes
analysis.failed_unobserved: retain planned opportunity denominator and unknown bounds; never complete-case pool or retry failed trial

scope: two task-bound native-model actors drawn from sixteen pinned boards; role and board type confounded; known historical evaluation mechanisms but disjoint from new fitted calibration; no new-blind/arbitrary-injection/mobile-robot claim; original CAGMC unchanged, no guard floor silently added
external_actuation: safe ECHO transaction ID only, disconnected loads confirmed
